blindness.declaration: No prediction, BL1 output, or prior outcome was consulted. The extractor contains no expected apogee.

files_opened_under_R6_public_cohort: blind-manifest.json only, plus the 12 listed flight logs (each hashed, then copied once; all work on the copies)

operational_definitions.altitude_channel_gps: ALT column (m MSL); AGL = ALT - median(ALT, 5 s before liftoff)
operational_definitions.liftoff: first sample t_i with t_i <= 10.0 s where some t_j >= t_i + 0.2 s has (z_j - z_i) > 3.0 m/s * (t_j - t_i)
operational_definitions.pad_median: median of the altitude samples inside the pad window
operational_definitions.apogee_pressure: max of the centred 5-sample running median of (sample - pad median), in metres AGL; earliest index wins ties
operational_definitions.apogee_gps: max of (ALT - pad median) in metres AGL; earliest index wins ties
operational_definitions.duplicate_policy_gps: rows with an identical UNIXTIME are merged; the file's duplicate rows were verified to carry identical ALT/FIX/FLAGS, so the first is kept

status_legend.usable: every applied exclusion rule passed; the apogee is a rule-compliant outcome
status_legend.excluded: at least one applied exclusion rule failed; not extractable under the frozen rules. The measured apogee is still recorded, but it must not be scored as an outcome.

E6_pad_reference.finding: No sealed log contains 5 s of pre-liftoff samples. Every file starts at or within 3.9 s of ignition, so the frozen E6 test (fewer than 5 s pre-liftoff samples) fails for all 12 flights.
E6_pad_reference.consequence: Under the rules as written there is no usable blind outcome in V001 or V002. This is a rule-versus-data incompatibility, not a defect of the flights.
E6_pad_reference.extractor_action: E6 was not amended. The measured apogees are reported with the only pad reference the data supports, and the incompatibility is escalated.

E3_recovery.finding: Four V001 flights trip the literal per-interval >20 m/s test on a single 0.05 s interval during a ~15 m/s drogue descent (barometric quantum 1.2 ft). The same flights' smoothed descent speed stays below the threshold.
E3_recovery.consequence: E3 verdicts are reported literally; the artefact is flagged, not overridden.

E4_V002_02.finding: The J270W log is also GPS-only (16 columns, no barometric channel), while the frozen E4 exemption names V002 I140W only.
E4_V002_02.consequence: V002-02 is excluded under E4 as written; its GPS maximum is reported as a diagnostic, not as a rule-compliant apogee.
